quote: Simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) translates input in real-time by incrementally processing partial segments rather than waiting the whole sentence completion.

We demonstrated that fine-tuning SiMT models with the LLM-SI-Corpus ... achieves better translation quality with minimal latency compared to models fine-tuned with other corpora and the pretrained model.
Simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) translates input in real-time by incrementally processing partial segments rather than waiting the whole sentence completion.
datasets: NAIST English-to-Japanese Chunk-Wise Monotonic Translation Evaluation Dataset
models: Transformer with Hubert-Large encoder and mBART50 decoder
outputs: Japanese translations generated incrementally with minimal latency
SI‑style translations used for training and evaluation of simultaneous machine translation systems
